mutations in CDKL5, DNM1, KCNT1, SCN1A, SCN2A, SCN8A, and UBA5 genes, which present severe pharmaco-resistant epilepsy, are increasingly becoming targets for RNA molecules that aim to restore neuronal excitability and network function
